008package paint.shared.io.internal;
009
010import paint.shared.objects.ExperimentInfo;
011
012import tech.tablesaw.api.Row;
013import tech.tablesaw.api.Table;
014
015import java.util.ArrayList;
016import java.util.List;
017
018/**
019 * Internal schema-validated table I/O implementation for {@link ExperimentInfo}.
020 *
021 * <p>This class handles:</p>
022 * <ul>
023 *   <li>Schema-correct table creation</li>
024 *   <li>Entity → table row conversion</li>
025 *   <li>Table row → entity conversion</li>
026 *   <li>Schema-aware append operations</li>
027 * </ul>
028 *
029 * <p>External modules must use MainIOInterface, never this class directly.</p>
030 */
031public class ExperimentInfoTableIO extends BaseTableIO {
032
033    // =====================================================================
034    //  TABLE CREATION
035    // =====================================================================
036
037    /**
038     * @return a new empty {@link Table} with the Experiment Info schema.
039     */
040    public Table emptyTable() {
041        return newEmptyTable("Experiment Info", ExperimentInfo.Column.values(), c -> c.header, c -> c.type);
042    }
043
044    // =====================================================================
045    //  ENTITY → TABLE CONVERSION
046    // =====================================================================
047
048    /**
049     * Converts a list of {@link ExperimentInfo} entities into a Tablesaw {@link Table}.
050     *
051     * @param infos list of experiment info objects to convert
052     * @return a table containing the metadata
053     */
054    public Table toTable(List<ExperimentInfo> infos) {
055        Table table = emptyTable();
056
057        for (ExperimentInfo info : infos) {
058            Row row = table.appendRow();
059
060            row.setString(ExperimentInfo.Column.EXPERIMENT_NAME.header,  info.getExperimentName());
061            row.setString(ExperimentInfo.Column.RECORDING_NAME.header,   info.getRecordingName());
062            row.setInt(   ExperimentInfo.Column.CONDITION_NUMBER.header, info.getConditionNumber());
063            row.setInt(   ExperimentInfo.Column.REPLICATE_NUMBER.header, info.getReplicateNumber());
064            row.setString(ExperimentInfo.Column.PROBE_NAME.header,       info.getProbeName());
065            row.setString(ExperimentInfo.Column.PROBE_TYPE.header,       info.getProbeType());
066            row.setString(ExperimentInfo.Column.CELL_TYPE.header,        info.getCellType());
067            row.setString(ExperimentInfo.Column.ADJUVANT.header,         info.getAdjuvant());
068            row.setDouble(ExperimentInfo.Column.CONCENTRATION.header,    info.getConcentration());
069            row.setBoolean(ExperimentInfo.Column.PROCESS_FLAG.header,    info.isProcessFlagSet());
070            row.setDouble(ExperimentInfo.Column.THRESHOLD.header,        info.getThreshold());
071        }
072
073        return table;
074    }
075
076    // =====================================================================
077    //  TABLE → ENTITY CONVERSION
078    // =====================================================================
079
080    /**
081     * Converts a Tablesaw {@link Table} into a list of {@link ExperimentInfo} entities.
082     *
083     * @param table the table to convert
084     * @return a list of experiment info objects
085     */
086    public List<ExperimentInfo> toEntities(Table table) {
087        List<ExperimentInfo> list = new ArrayList<>();
088
089        for (Row row : table) {
090            ExperimentInfo info = new ExperimentInfo();
091
092            info.setExperimentName( row.getString( ExperimentInfo.Column.EXPERIMENT_NAME.header ));
093            info.setRecordingName(  row.getString( ExperimentInfo.Column.RECORDING_NAME.header ));
094            info.setConditionNumber(row.getInt(    ExperimentInfo.Column.CONDITION_NUMBER.header ));
095            info.setReplicateNumber(row.getInt(    ExperimentInfo.Column.REPLICATE_NUMBER.header ));
096            info.setProbeName(      row.getString( ExperimentInfo.Column.PROBE_NAME.header ));
097            info.setProbeType(      row.getString( ExperimentInfo.Column.PROBE_TYPE.header ));
098            info.setCellType(       row.getString( ExperimentInfo.Column.CELL_TYPE.header ));
099            info.setAdjuvant(       row.getString( ExperimentInfo.Column.ADJUVANT.header ));
100            info.setConcentration(  row.getDouble( ExperimentInfo.Column.CONCENTRATION.header ));
101            info.setProcessFlag(    row.getBoolean(ExperimentInfo.Column.PROCESS_FLAG.header ));
102            info.setThreshold(      row.getDouble( ExperimentInfo.Column.THRESHOLD.header ));
103
104            list.add(info);
105        }
106
107        return list;
108    }
109}
